test_title: PYST 8: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All sharks are salmons.

Some salmons are tunas.

Conclusions:

I. Some sharks are tunas.

II. No tunas are sharks.
solution:
Given Statements:

All sharks are salmons.

Some salmons are tunas.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/737f62b6a1ef807e91a2e70e55d867017271211c69b296bcf7a32b88f5942ede.png] 

Conclusions:

**I. Some sharks are tunas:****
Conclusion I is FALSE:** The "Some salmons are tunas" overlap could happen entirely within the part of the Salmons set that is **NOT** the Sharks set.

In this case, the **Sharks** circle has **NO** overlap with the **Tunas** circle.**
**II. No tunas are sharks:**

Conclusion II is FALSE:** The salmons that are tunas could include one or more sharks.

In this case, the **Sharks** circle **DOES** overlap with the **Tunas** circle.

So, **Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
